method: story-id aliases (bot-written each run, apart from the owner-reviewed web/verdicts.json): the day's stories are compared with the previous pulse.json. A post is its network and its post time, never its link (a Mastodon link comes and goes with the render check, and pulse.json publishes no post id); newsletter issues are left out because one issue carries many stories. An earlier story maps to the story of the day that holds the most of its posts when that is at least half of them and more than the story under its own id still holds (a tie keeps no alias; among other stories the lower id wins). The map is cumulative: an old alias follows its target's move, an alias back to itself is dropped, and since = the BRT date the alias was first written. A verdict row resolves through an alias before a live story of the same id, because the alias names the story that took its posts
